name: Ferienwohnung Tragseil
beschreibung:
Quietly set in Thiersee, Ferienwohnung Tragseil welcomes visitors with a cosy ambiance, bright rooms, and a scenic balcony overlooking the mountains.

Lake Thiersee and hiking paths up Mount Pendling are reachable within minutes.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Tragseil in Thiersee offers relaxing holidays and mountain views in sunny Kufsteinerland.
